paths.boundaryTitle: Path grants are not a sandbox
paths.boundaryDescription: Read and write grants control OpenGUI's project and file operations. They do not confine commands run by an unrestricted Shell, which has the Host operating-system user's authority.

instructions.hierarchy: Host instructions apply everywhere. Shared project instructions apply to everyone working in that project. When they conflict, Host instructions win.

helpScope.personal: Private to you and added to every prompt you send. Don't include secrets.
